description: Measures whether executive impact briefs remain complete, actionable, and grounded in structured compliance evidence.

obligations.summary: Apply enhanced identity checks to agent transactions above KES 70,000.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Agents shall inspect identity documents, capture a biometric, and verify a one-time password above KES 70,000.

obligations.summary: Report suspicious agent transactions to the FRC within 24 hours.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The MLRO shall file suspicious agent transaction reports with the Financial Reporting Centre within twenty-four hours.

matches.chunkText: The MLRO reports suspicious channel activity to the FRC within 24 hours.

obligations.summary: Retain agent identification and transaction records for seven years.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Agent identification and transaction records shall be retained for seven years.

obligations.summary: Maintain a Liquidity Coverage Ratio of at least 110 percent.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Institutions shall maintain an LCR not lower than 110 percent.

matches.chunkText: Treasury maintains the LCR at or above 110 percent.

obligations.summary: Perform liquidity stress testing every quarter.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Liquidity stress tests shall be completed quarterly.

matches.chunkText: Treasury Risk runs liquidity stress scenarios every quarter.

obligations.summary: Report quarterly liquidity stress results to the Board Risk Committee.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Results shall be submitted to the Board Risk Committee each quarter.

matches.chunkText: Quarterly liquidity stress results are tabled at the Board Risk Committee.

obligations.summary: Complete ownership, sanctions, financial, and security due diligence before appointing a critical provider.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: A regulated institution shall perform due diligence before engaging a critical service provider.

obligations.summary: Include bank and regulator audit rights in critical provider contracts.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Critical outsourcing agreements shall grant audit rights to the institution and regulator.

obligations.summary: Maintain a tested exit plan for every critical outsourced service.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Institutions shall document and test an exit strategy for each critical service.

obligations.summary: Disclose the total cost of credit before a customer accepts a digital loan.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The total cost of credit shall be displayed before acceptance.

matches.chunkText: The application displays total credit cost before loan acceptance.

obligations.summary: Capture and retain explicit customer consent for every digital credit agreement.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Providers shall retain evidence of explicit consent for each agreement.

obligations.summary: Provide an in-application channel for digital credit complaints.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: A complaint channel shall be accessible within the digital lending interface.

matches.chunkText: Digital lending customers can lodge complaints from the mobile application.

obligations.summary: Report material cyber incidents to the regulator within four hours.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Material cyber incidents shall be reported within four hours of detection.

matches.chunkText: Compliance notifies the regulator of material cyber incidents within four hours.

obligations.summary: Test recovery of critical digital services twice each year.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Recovery arrangements for critical digital services shall be tested semi-annually.

obligations.summary: Require the board to review operational resilience metrics every quarter.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The board shall review resilience metrics on a quarterly basis.

matches.chunkText: The Board Risk Committee reviews resilience metrics each quarter.
